arrangement.notes: Vocal-focused arrangement with aggressive mood and club energy profile using modern sample chopping techniques. Channels named after sample chopping styles.

event_markers.label: Verse 1 Start
event_markers.reason: Beat fully enters with sample chopping kicks and snares

event_markers.label: Final Hook
event_markers.reason: Maximum vocal energy and chopping variations

event_markers.label: Outro Start
event_markers.reason: Energy wind down with simplified drum chops

track_roles.drums: Sample chopped drum patterns with aggressive punch
track_roles.bass: Deep rhythmic bass grooves complementing vocal focus
track_roles.melody: Complementary riffs with subtle sample chops
track_roles.vocal: Primary vocal track with chopped vocal samples emphasizing aggression
track_roles.fx: Ambient and transition effects using modern sample chopping

sensei_drum.brief: Generate aggressive West Coast style drum patterns focusing on modern sample chopping techniques like slicing, glitch effects, and stutter edits.

bass_generator.brief: Create deep bass grooves that lock tightly with the drum pattern, maintaining aggressive club energy while complementing vocal rhythm.

harmony_generator.brief: Add sparse chord layers that enhance the mood without overcrowding the vocal focus, using subtle sample chopping to texture the harmony.

melody_generator.brief: Compose minimal melodic lines with modern chopping effects to support and contrast the vocal track.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement dynamics and ensure an energetic flow emphasizing vocal intensity and chopped sample layers.

presetor.brief: Apply presets that support aggressive and clean sample chops across drums, vocals, and FX channels, maintaining clarity and punch.

songgps.brief: Manage section transitions, energy curve, and marker placements to reflect arrangement flow for West Coast hip-hop.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare for mix by maintaining unprocessed channel audio, ensuring vocal presence and clarity in final mix stages.
